name: TokenRes pre_qk
authorization: User asks to follow the original attention normalization; validate revision and automatically submit one fresh authorized10B, no revival of raw TokenRes.

architecture.tokenres: u=Sublayer(RMSNorm(x)); Q=1.2 RMSNorm_head(Wq(RMSNorm(u))), K=1.2 RMSNorm_head(Wk(RMSNorm(x))), V=Wv(RMSNorm(x)); output=u+Wo(causal_swa(Q,K,V))
architecture.sharing: One separate Q/K/V/O module per block, called twice; not shared across blocks
architecture.cache_decoding: Rejected until separate per-sublayer cache states are implemented
architecture.position_note: This revision adopts original attention normalization; TokenRes positional encoding remains unchanged (no new RoPE).

initialization.unchanged: Embedding/head/backbone QKV/MLP-up initial values and caller RNG
initialization.changed: Backbone attention O uniform+-sqrt(3/D), MLP-down uniform+-sqrt(3/(4D)); nonzero because no identity path
initialization.tokenres: Q/K/V uniform+-sqrt(3/D); O uniform+-0.1sqrt(3/D). No runtime alpha or gate.
initialization.caveat: Original no-identity nonzero initialization retained to isolate normalization change. Inspect all16 sublayers at init,50,128,250,500,768,1024steps.

training.optimizer: Original MuonAdamW, matrices including shared TokenRes use original Muon grouping/LR/WD; no clipping
training.data: Existing ready FineWeb-Edu2K cache; dev/test/order/tokenizer unchanged
training.checkpoint: Latest500 overwrite, best separate,1800s exit85 durable transfer and full-state resume
training.post_step_guard: Check all TokenRes model parameters finite after original optimizer.step; no clipping or optimizer arithmetic changes.

gate.profile: Same GPU baseline/tokenres, two orders each20warmup30timed, actual optimizer steps
gate.stability: Two independent process profiles continue to1024 unique steps (33,554,432tokens each), horizon305176; original RMS(0,100), hidden gradient RMS<1, parameter gradient norm<1e4, every update post-parameter finite guard. Numerical thresholds are failure guards, not proof of convergence or training quality.

comparison: The older full10B baseline used FLA; same-GPU performance gate uses FA3 for both. No new formal baseline/sweep. Extra parameters and FLOPs are reported, not claimed free.
monitor: User permits background automatic gate audit/publication/10B submission; no repeated interactive polling/status reports. Exit after first finite formal step.
checkpoint_compatibility: Raw TokenRes checkpoints require archived source; normalization metadata must be pre_qk. Retained vanilla/native/mHC checkpoints remain loadable.
